reviews.text: Very professional service and accommodating. Easy to communicate with. Will be taking my puppy regularly!

Hi Alexander,

I’m sorry you were unhappy with your experience. However, I want to clarify what happened for the safety and well-being of your cat.

When you brought your cat in for grooming and nail trimming, I discovered that several of the nails had grown into the paw pads/skin and were already causing bleeding and significant pain. The cat was also extremely sensitive and would not allow me to safely handle the paws.

Because I was concerned that attempting to continue the nail trimming could cause further pain or injury, I immediately contacted you and asked you to come back and take your cat to a veterinarian so the nails could be properly treated and the cat could receive the appropriate medical care.

My priority was the animal’s safety. As a groomer, I cannot provide veterinary treatment for nails that have grown into the skin or treat an injured paw. I believe veterinary attention was necessary to prevent further pain and complications.

I sincerely hope your cat received the care needed and is feeling better.

Brought my 11 year old, disabled, long haired cat for a lion cut as she was matted and had a hard time cleaning herself. Tatiana was amazing and cleaned her right up, had her nails trimmed and ears cleaned in a very reasonable turn around time. Thank you for taking such great care of my baby!
My dog Malcolm is always so happy after a visit with Tatiana.  She is a fantastic groomer!
Thank you so much for fitting our dog in on such short notice after her skunk encounter! You did such an amazing job and she smells so much better and looks great!

Natalia, was super sweet to my dog.  My dog is a senior dog almost approaching 16 years.  So he is delicate and doesn't really enjoy bath tume.  Natalia was so caring took her time and I felt my dog was so relaxed and  happy when I picked him up.  He also looked 10 times better than before.  I highly recommend this place.  Natalia really loves pets and I am sure she will do what ever she can to make them feel comfortable.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Tatiana at Petville Spa. She was absolutely incredible from start to finish. Her patience, kindness, and genuine care made the entire experience exceptional. Tatiana took the time to listen, made us few completely comfortable leaving our little Yorkie River with her and went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect.  River was quite matted and Tatiana groomed her perfectly.    It’s rare to find someone so dedicated to providing outstanding service while making every client feel truly valued. The level of attention and care she provides is simply unmatched.

Tatiana is beyond five stars—she is an absolute gem and a true asset to Petville Spa. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for an amazing experience. Thank you, Tatiana, for your outstanding care of River and exceptional service!   We are grateful.
Connie and Cristian
Before and after

My spouse and I took our two young cats to Petville Spa today, to have their nails clipped. The service was well done, fast and friendly - and was much easier than doing it at home, where my cats usually wriggle free. I'll definitely be making return visits!

It has been over a year since our visit, yet grooming our dog is still a challenge. He no longer tolerates being groomed and, since that appointment, we have had to do everything at home because he will not allow anyone else to handle him. We suspect he may have been restrained too forcefully, as he remains especially sensitive around his front paws. It took nearly three months for him to feel comfortable with bathing again.
In addition, the haircut did not match our request. We clearly emphasized that his ears should not be shaved; however, when my husband picked him up, ears had been completely shaved.

I have been using Tatiana, who owns Petville Spa for my dogs for many years, even before Petville was established. Her care and skill with grooming the dogs is by far the best I have ever experienced and the environment is spotlessly clean, warm and inviting. I would never consider taking my beloved pets anywhere else. We are so thankful to have her in our lives❤️⭐️

I am new to the area and took my dog to Petville Spa on Mt Pleasant Rd for grooming.  Tamara is lovely and did a wonderful job.  My dog loves her and the treats.  We are extremely happy with his grooming and the friendly service. We have continued to go back and highly recommend them.  🐕‍🦺 …

After multiple visits, I can confidently say this place is not worth it.

My first experience was acceptable, although the price increased from $100 to $110 due to “dog behavior,” which I did not question. I gave the business multiple chances and also brought my second dog, expecting consistency.

However, an issue occurred prior to my last visit that raised serious concerns. After one grooming appointment, my dog returned home showing discomfort in his tail. The following day, while I was traveling, the area began bleeding and I observed a cut (photos available). When I raised this upon returning to Toronto, responsibility was denied. At the time, I accepted that explanation, but the timing of the injury — immediately following the appointment — remains concerning.

Despite this, I chose to give the business another opportunity.

My most recent visit did not meet expected grooming standards. The haircut was poorly executed — the face was not shaped in the typical round style for the breed, and the neck area appeared uneven and inconsistent with the rest of the body.

The response to my concerns was also disappointing. I was told the groomer was busy, that “it’s just hair,” and that my dog moves during grooming. While movement can happen, managing it is part of the service. At a price of $120, a basic level of care and professionalism is expected.

I was initially told I could return to have the haircut adjusted. However, when I followed up, I was informed that I was “too picky” and that my dogs would no longer be accepted as clients.

Expecting an appropriate standard of service — particularly when it involves a pet — should not be characterized negatively but that's how Tatiana's operates.

I continued using this place primarily due to its proximity to my home, but based on these experiences I chose not to return nor would  recommend. So disappointed.
Tatiana is absolutely amazing and professional! My dog looks beautiful, fresh and clean every single time😍 …

Brought my Pomsky here for the first
time today & he came back handsome and clean! He was happy and seemed as if Tatiana took good care of him during his stay! I would recommend this place for sure!

After several visits, I can finally say that I’d like to leave a positive review about this place. Our dog is extremely precious to us, like everyone’s pet, and since birth he had always gone to the same groomer. After we moved to Toronto, I was looking for a place where I could leave him with complete peace of mind and be confident in the quality of the work. Thankfully, I found exactly the right place.

Tatiana is very attentive and sensitive in her approach. She gives dogs the time they need to get comfortable with her and, even if it takes hours, she puts in the effort to do the best job possible. She takes great care of our boy, Kaju, and every single time we leave, we are very happy with both the bath and the haircut. I definitely recommend her.

I’ve seen some negative comments about pricing, but I personally find her very transparent. She provides a price range based on the time required and the dog’s breed, so you don’t really encounter any unpleasant surprises.
